app.title: High Tech Lab visit
gate.body: Walk through a 3D scan of the High Tech Lab at maakleerplek, Leuven, and find its machines.
tip.desktop.1: Tip: walk up to a machine and face it to discover it.
tip.desktop.2: Tip: press H for an arrow to the next objective.
tip.desktop.3: Tip: walk up to a machine and its card opens by itself. You can keep walking while it is open.
tip.desktop.4: Tip: Escape frees the mouse and opens the pause menu.
tip.desktop.5: Tip: hold Shift to walk faster.
tip.touch.1: Tip: walk up to a machine and face it to discover it.
tip.touch.2: Tip: tap Hint for an arrow to the next objective.
tip.touch.3: Tip: walk up to a machine and its card opens by itself. You can keep walking while it is open.
tip.touch.4: Tip: drag with your right thumb to look around.
tip.touch.5: Tip: tap the map to see the whole lab and its machines.
intro.body: Find the {total} machines and workstations of the lab. Walk up to one and face it: its card opens by itself.
intro.controlsDesktop: Click the view, then move the mouse to look around. W A S D or arrow keys to walk. Walk up to a machine to read about it. H for a hint.
intro.controlsTouch: Left thumb to walk. Drag with your right thumb to look around. Walk up to a machine to read about it.
